requirements.text: Use eight LED packages in one series string.
requirements.acceptance: An independent connectivity review identifies one current path through exactly eight packages.

requirements.text: Deliver 750–850 lm after the diffuser with CRI at least 80 in 2700 K, 4000 K and 6500 K versions.
requirements.basis: E27 Rev A product report, optical and protection requirements
requirements.acceptance: Measure stabilized flux and CRI for each CCT using the intended diffuser. Evaluate bins and fixed current selection using at least three development inserts per CCT and several lots before series.

requirements.text: Target junction temperature at most 95°C in rated operation.
requirements.basis: E27 Rev A product report, optical and protection requirements
requirements.acceptance: Derive the hottest junction temperature from measured solder-point temperature and the selected LED thermal model at approved ambient conditions.

requirements.text: Drive one isolated current-regulated LED output, with a separate removal shutdown and thermal protection function.
requirements.basis: Owner's 8S decision and E27 Rev A shutdown architecture
requirements.acceptance: Agree the driver and insert power contact numbers, polarities, source/sink voltage and current envelopes, startup, open/short, removal, thermal behavior and independent cutoff before schematic work.

requirements.text: Limit accessible contact voltage to 30 V DC including peaks in a single fault, and reach below 5 V within 100 ms after normal opening.
requirements.basis: E27 Rev A product report, optical and protection requirements
requirements.acceptance: Measure the contact voltage and elapsed discharge time under approved normal opening and single-fault test conditions.

requirements.text: Retain reinforced isolation from mains to accessible parts.
requirements.basis: E27 Rev A product report, optical and protection requirements
requirements.acceptance: Approve insulation classification and verify the complete assembly by the applicable test plan.

requirements.text: Fit the constant-current driver and required protection functions on one power PCB.
requirements.basis: Packaging objective from the 8S architecture discussion
requirements.acceptance: Review all required functions, physical fit, thermal path and assembly access against the actual enclosure envelope.

requirements.text: Use a confirmed JLCPCB fabrication and assembly process for the proposed board.
requirements.basis: Project owner supplier direction and pinned JLCPCB profile
requirements.acceptance: Record the selected fabrication and assembly service and applicable capability constraints. Verify the actual stackup, laminate and assembly-specific release inputs at their own gates.

requirements.text: Operate from 207–253 VAC, 50 Hz, per the current design baseline.
requirements.basis: E27 baseline report and prototype handoff
requirements.acceptance: Verify startup, regulated output and fault behavior throughout the input range.

implementation.object: Operate from 207–253 VAC, 50 Hz, per the current design baseline.

requirements.text: Establish the mains-to-accessible insulation design basis.
requirements.basis: E27 baseline report and prototype handoff
requirements.acceptance: Review complete assembly classification, laminate, isolation geometry and accessible-contact sequence before layout.

implementation.object: Establish the mains-to-accessible insulation design basis.

requirements.text: Meet applicable complete-lamp EMC, immunity, input and temporal light requirements.
requirements.basis: E27 baseline report and prototype handoff
requirements.acceptance: Record test basis and measured EMC, individual harmonics, PF/DF and PstLM/SVM results under approved conditions.

implementation.object: Meet applicable complete-lamp EMC, immunity, input and temporal light requirements.

requirements.text: Keep the electrolytic case at or below 85°C at 40°C ambient.
requirements.basis: E27 baseline report and prototype handoff
requirements.acceptance: Measure stabilized case temperature in the worst approved orientation and fixture.

implementation.object: Keep the electrolytic case at or below 85°C at 40°C ambient.

requirements.text: Verify the final driver assembly and fabrication inputs.
requirements.basis: E27 baseline report and prototype handoff
requirements.acceptance: Review actual panel, BOM, exact MPNs, T1, material record and through-hole scope with the intended manufacturing process.

implementation.object: Verify the final driver assembly and fabrication inputs.

unknowns.question: Confirm the proposed fabrication and assembly service and capability constraints for the driver.
Agree the cold string voltage and drive-current design bounds and the exact contacts, thermostat and removal behavior.
Confirm available enclosure envelope, maximum part heights, contact access and thermal mounting.
Confirm supplier bins and measure hot luminous flux and CRI for all CCT variants.
Define rated ambient and record temperature data from the intended assembly.
Confirm applicable classification and tests for the complete mains-powered assembly.
Define fault injection points and record worst-case contact peaks and discharge time.
Agree insulation classification, material inputs and accessible contact sequence.
Agree test classification, applicable EMC and temporal light limits and laboratory conditions.
Confirm the LED insert MCPCB fabrication, mounting and assembly process separately from the FR-4 driver.
